answer: A borrowed identity cannot occupy two docks at once. An applicant escrows 7.15 POA and is assigned one landing slot on a barrier island for 11 minutes. They must carry a live lotus token across a 420-meter dune boardwalk and radio a 16-bit sand-grain checksum at minute 8. Three tide-wardens recompute the checksum from the token serial and the boardwalk camera. If two applicants share a slot or a checksum Hamming distance under 2, both escrows are slashed and the slot is retired for 36 hours. A missed minute-8 radio is abandonment and the 7.15 stake stays locked until the next tide window.
